correctness.rationale: Proof establishes all hypotheses (integer n≥4; directed cycles with one-way increasing arcs). At most two vertices per directed cycle fibre, hence eight upper bound. The monotone-rectangle dynamic recurrence is equivalent to existence of shortest directed selected-internal-vertex-free paths for all ordered pairs; complete enumeration excludes the only two smaller widths and is independently checked by BFS. Explicit five/seven/eight-point witnesses exist. Empty-column insertion proves the eight-point witness survives for every n≥6, without finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: Provides a complete and exact infinite family for the directed variant introduced in 2026, with a sharp transition at width six and uniform eventual capacity. Its constant bound contrasts substantively with the published undirected 12-point torus value from width eight, identifying the effect of one-way arc orientation; the proof separates universal geometric obstruction from only two finite boundary cases.
